title: [Itch demo] I made a clicker incremental game where you play as an evil tech CEO automating all human labor with AI and robots
author: funkyway
selftext:
**Hey everyone!** 👋🏻  
I'm a UI designer with a dream of making games. This is the first game I actually plan to release. I started working on it in May and plan to release it in November.

**How I made it:**  
I'm using Godot for the engine. Because I'm not a coder myself, I'm using Gemini in Antigravity (Gemini 3.5-3.8 flash) for the code.

**The art:**  
I'm also not a pixel artist, so for the art I used Retro Diffusion and Aseprite to manually clean up some slop. As you can see, each screen has pixel art on the right side. I managed to make them all in the same style (same platform, colors, etc.) with the "My Styles" feature in Retro Diffusion. The art comes out really good, but I still felt that it needs some manual cleanup in Aseprite. 

**The UI:**  
I designed the UI myself in Figma, then sent screenshots of my designs to the agent and told it to copy my designs to the best of its ability. It was pretty good at turning the screenshots into code, but I had to do some back-and-forth. Mostly to make the spacing between elements exactly as I wanted.

**The sounds:**  
For most of the sounds, I used ElevenLabs' text-to-SFX, then combined and edited them in Audacity. Some of the sounds are CC0 that I found on Itch. For the speech events in-game, I recorded myself, then ran it through ElevenLabs' voice changer. 

The game has a [playable demo on Itch.](https://funkyway.itch.io/click-to-obsolete) And there is also a [Steam page](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4972790/Click_to_Obsolete/) if you want to wishlist it.
